lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Sort into language, food, custom or celebration: Auslan; dumplings; shaking hands when meeting; Lunar New Year.

FEEDBACK
Auslan: language; dumplings: food; shaking hands: custom; Lunar New Year: celebration.

WATCH FOR
Believing everyone from a country shares exactly the same culture ignores individual and family differences.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Make a culture web for yourself or for a published example using five categories. Add one thing that is shared with others in your community and one that is different. Share only what you feel comfortable sharing.

Write a short reflection naming one source or idea you corrected and why.

Add one thing that is shared with others in your community and one that is different. Share only what you feel comfortable sharing. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Likely misconception: Believing everyone from a country shares exactly the same culture ignores individual and family differences. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Produce a fresh example demonstrating culture on new material (not the worked model). Explain the particular words, sources or choices that make it work.

This helps the learner base claims on sources, places and respectful community knowledge, rather than guessing from a single picture. Keep every claim linked to evidence.
